Method of Attack: Compromising user accounts to gain access to repositories, wiping all commit history and code, and leaving a ransom note demanding 0.1 BTC payment to recover data
Attack Vector: Use of stolen login credentials from third-party services to access accounts
Credential reuse from other compromised services
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom note commit named 'WARNING' in compromised repositories
27 reports on BitcoinAbuse platform for the Bitcoin address
392 impacted repositories on GitHub with wiped commits
